events.name: PlaySoundEffect
events.path: [<SLOW, FAMILIAR FOOTSTEPS APPROACHING FROM BEHIND WILLIAM>]

segments.text: Is that what you tell yourself to sleep at night, Will?
Come now... you and I both know how that night really ended.
We were standing right beside your bedroom window, weren't we?

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE ROOM WALLS BEGIN TO WARP AND DARKEN AT THE EDGES]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM GASPS SHARPLY AS THE MEMORY CRASHES OVER HIM, SNAPPING HIM BACK INTO THE COLD ROOM]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [NATHANIEL’S GENTLE SMILE VANISHES. A YELLOW FLAME IGNITES ALONG HIS COLLAR AND RAPIDLY SPREADS ACROSS HIS JAW, HAIR, AND FACE, BURNING SILENTLY]

segments.text: You didn't just let me fall, Will.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM CLUTCHES HIS CHEST AND BACKS AWAY IN TERROR AGAINST THE HEAVY OAK DOOR]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE FLAMES CONSUMING NATHANIEL BEGIN TO FLICKER AND THIN OUT LIKE DYING SMOKE. HIS BURNING SILHOUETTE SLOWLY DISSOLVES INTO THE CORRIDOR SHADOWS UNTIL NOTHING REMAINS]

events.name: PlaySoundEffect
events.path: [<SILENCE, WITH A FAINT AMBIENCE OF THE COLD ROOM>]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE FAINT SMELL OF KEROSENE AND ASH LINGERS IN THE FREEZING AIR]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [AFTER A MOMENT OF SILENCE, WILLIAM BENDS DOWN WITH A TREMBLING HAND, THEN TURNS BACK TO SEARCH THE SECRET ROOM]
